verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: Your account has been created successfully.
verifyEmail.bannerBody: We have sent a verification link to your email address. Check your inbox (and your spam folder) and click the link to activate your account.
verifyEmail.notReceived: Haven't received the email? Check your spam folder, make sure the address is correct, and wait a few minutes.

verify.verifyingBody: Please wait while we verify your account.
verify.successBannerBody: Your account has been verified successfully. You will be redirected to sign in automatically.
verify.expiredHint: If the link has expired, you can request a new verification email by signing in to your account.

confirmed.verifyingBody: Please wait while we confirm your email address.
confirmed.successDefault: Your account has been verified successfully.
confirmed.welcomeIntro: Your account is now active and you can:
confirmed.welcome1: Sign in with your email and password
confirmed.alreadyDefault: This account has already been confirmed.
confirmed.already3: You don't need to confirm your email again
confirmed.errorDefault: There was a problem verifying your email address.
confirmed.cause2: The link has already been used
confirmed.cause3: The link is damaged or incomplete
confirmed.solution1: Try registering again with the same email
confirmed.solution3: Contact support if the problem persists

resetRequest.title: Forgot your password?

resetRequest.successBannerBody: We've sent you an email with instructions to reset your password. Check your inbox and your spam folder.
resetRequest.sendError: Could not send the recovery email

resetConfirm.invalidBannerBody: The recovery link is invalid or has expired.

resetConfirm.title: Set a password
resetConfirm.subtitle: Enter your new password.
resetConfirm.tokenExpired: The recovery link has expired or is invalid. Request a new one.
